title: fix(currentRefinements): reset page number on refine
body:
### [FX-1834](https://algolia.atlassian.net/browse/FX-1834)

**Summary**

All refinement widgets but `currentRefinements` reset the pagination.
This can result in users seeing "No results" when clearing a refinement narrows the results.

**Result**

Added test to make sure we reset pagination when calling `refine` on `currentRefinements`
